title: Shielded Org Mode: tenant-level export & sharing curbs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a tenant-level 'Shielded Org Mode' feature that centralizes compliance toggles for IP allowlisting, disabling public sharing, and restricting data export. This ticket covers backend RBAC v2 checks, SSO/SAML-enforced admin only controls, audit event generation for every toggle change and export attempt, and a Console surface for Operators to view and manage settings. The goal is to give compliance teams an easily auditable, enforceable knob to lock down data exfiltration vectors without requiring VM-level network changes.
acceptance_criteria: Operators can enable Shielded Org Mode from Console and toggle: IP allowlist, disable public sharing, disable data export
RBAC v2 enforces toggle write permissions: only role 'org_security_admin' can change toggles
SSO/SAML org-wide enforcement: IdP group mapping documented and tested
All toggle changes emit structured audit events (who, what, when, previous_value, ip_context) and persist to audit-log service
Attempted export or public share actions when Shielded Org Mode blocks them are rejected with 403 and logged with reason code
Migration: existing orgs default to disabled; opt-in process with telemetry captured
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Backend feature flag behind 'shielded_org_mode' for 10% internal orgs; Phase 2: Console UI behind feature flag with audit stream to test bucket; Phase 3: Gradual ramp to all new orgs, opt-in for existing orgs; final enforcement gated on security signoff
implementation_notes: Backend: Add tenant-level config object (read-through cache) exposed to runtime routing decisions
RBAC: Integrate with RBAC v2 evaluation path; add permission 'org:manage_shielded_mode' assigned to org_security_admin
SSO: Add IdP group mapping docs and automatic assignment for initial rollout
Audit: Emit event type 'shielded_mode.change' and 'shielded_mode.blocked_action' with structured metadata
Edge cases: service accounts and system integrations must be allowlisted via admin-managed API keys with explicit export permission
Fallback: Provide emergency override flow for infra with justification logged and emailed to security ops
security_considerations: Ensure audit logs are immutable for 90 days and forwarded to customer-managed SIEM when Private mode selected. KMS keys used for any exported manifests must respect customer key policy. RBAC changes must be backward compatible for org admins. Document threat model for insider exfiltration and mitigation steps.
qa_plan: Unit tests for enforcement paths (allow vs block) with RBAC matrix
Integration tests exercising SSO group mapping and toggle change audit events
E2E test in staging org with sample export attempts from SDK and Console
Red-team style test to attempt exfil via alternate channels (embeddings export, coach logs)
docs_and_communication: Customer-facing KB article draft: Shielded Org Mode overview and migration guide
